_comment: Copy to whitelist.json and list ONLY the chats Claude may read from and send to. Individual JIDs end in @s.whatsapp.net, groups in @g.us. Run `uv run python whitelist_cli.py chats` to discover JIDs (or `whitelist_cli.py add <name>` to add one). An empty or missing whitelist.json denies all access (fail closed).
